kind: TM02 v1 section 5.2.2 / Figure 14 multi-history extension reimplementation

config.purpose: R2 Fig.14 multi-history execution contract. Extend the existing single-history runner before execution; this configuration is not a completed result.

source.scope: TM02 v1 Sections 4.3 and 5.2.2, Fig.14: ideal 100 histories x 100 increments; noisy is a separately labeled project extension. Other training methods are outside this round.

config.implementation: Extend the existing JAX implementation with independent complete sequences, dataset-wide normalization, full-dataset gradient accumulation and paired old/new evaluation. Do not rewrite the material model.

reference_material.constitutive_interpretation: Eq.29 is implemented as V=[(1-o)*exp(-(norm_F(sigma_ov)/a)^b)+o]*V0: dimensionless o multiplies the full fourth-order V0 tensor. Table 1 eta_K=400 and eta_D=200 are interpreted in MPa*s, because Eq.27 differentiated with respect to strain rate must yield MPa. The printed tensor-plus-scalar and MPa/s are ambiguous; this is the project's dimensional interpretation, not verified author code.

data.bound_rule: resample increment when the proposed knot exceeds the paper's bound

train.initial_state: q0=h0=c0=0 for each independently prepared history; never reset inside a history

data.project_choices: Explicit seeds, natural spline boundary condition, paired ideal/noisy histories, 20 held-out paths and execution budget are project choices. Do not select paths based on model errors or change the reference material to an easier law.

dissipation.convex_activation_provenance: project choice permitted by Appendix A.2; Table 4 leaves this entry unspecified

model.corrections: Preserve free-energy zero-state and dissipation zero-rate corrections as defined in the paper.
model.normalization: Appendix A.3 from the entire 100-history training set per condition, fixed across initialization groups/microbatches. Compute strain rates within each history before pooling. Reference internal variables and all evaluation arrays are excluded.

loss.note: Use the original RNN Eqs.23-25, averaged equally over 100 histories x 100 increments x 6 physical components. No additional multi-step, ranking or critic loss.

training.budget_provenance: Ideal 100x100 follows Fig.14. Noisy 100x100 is a project extension. 25 initializations, 20,000 updates and the existing learning-rate schedule are the fixed project budget, not a claim that Fig.14 reports every setting.
training.gradient_accumulation: Differentiate each complete 100-increment sequence. Average gradients over all 100 histories before exactly one Adam update; microbatches do not increment Adam or the learning-rate schedule separately.

prediction.figures: Fig.14 ideal multi-history correlation; complete stress histories and paired old/new errors on all held-out paths; noisy plots labeled project extension
prediction.normalization_for_comparison: Use raw MPa as the primary cross-model metric. Historical model-specific training half-range NRMSE is not directly comparable to the new model's NRMSE. Any added normalized metric must use one explicitly recorded common scale for all model groups.

numerics.integration: implicit Euler, Newton-Raphson with residual-merit backtracking; no time subdivision or alternate solver
numerics.shear_convention: tensor components; tensor gradients divide shear derivatives by 2

implementation_choices.positive_weights: softplus of unconstrained parameters; initialized with abs(Glorot uniform)+0.01 then inverse softplus
implementation_choices.other_weights: NumPy default_rng(seed) Glorot uniform; biases zero; same initialization for paired ideal/noisy runs
implementation_choices.output_activations: linear FICNN and PICNN output; softplus hidden convex layers, tanh hidden nonconvex layer
implementation_choices.normalization: A.3 midpoint/half-range for each invariant from training strain and finite-difference strain rate; scalar component-wide strain/stress ranges for RNN; q,p estimated from strain only; potential scale s_e*s_sigma, dissipation scale s_edot*s_sigma (MPa/s). Potential offsets cancel in zero-state corrections.
implementation_choices.initial_state: q0=0 and LSTM h0=c0=0 separately for each complete history; no auxiliary pretraining
implementation_choices.loss_components: equal mean over 100 independent histories, 100 increments each, and six independent physical tensor components
implementation_choices.path_rng_order: sample clock then spline knots; reject only offending component increments

execution.grouping_note: Group sizes may change to fit the existing GPU, but complete histories, full-dataset averaged gradients, one Adam step per dataset pass and the total scientific budget must not change.

outputs.release_contents: all 50 final weights, optimizer states, 20,000-step loss curves per run, actual training/evaluation arrays, all predictions, revisit arrays, source/config versions and compact figures

known_hard_path.role: known diagnostic path, already inspected; not a new blind test

comparison.statistics: Report the path and initialization axes separately; do not count 2000 predictions or within-path time points as independent physical histories.
comparison.attribution: Any gain first supports expanded training-history coverage under the original method, not a new algorithm.

revisit_comparison.selected_models: one ideal and one noisy model selected by minimum final training loss; 12 complete histories each
revisit_comparison.outcome: positive magnitude of peak compressive strain during the common later probe; retain original integral and full-history outputs
revisit_comparison.scope: All six original reference pairs favor early. Rank agreement alone cannot demonstrate history-dependent decision value or robot control benefit.

known_hard_path.role: known diagnostic path, already inspected; not a new blind test

frozen_comparison.statistics: Report the path and initialization axes separately; do not count 2000 predictions or within-path time points as independent physical histories.
frozen_comparison.attribution: Any gain first supports expanded training-history coverage under the original method, not a new algorithm.

error_definition: MPa; equal weight for six independent physical tensor components; time zero excluded. Hydrostatic error is mean of three normal stress errors. Deviatoric error subtracts that mean from normal components; shear unchanged.
normalization_comparison: No cross-model NRMSE comparison; every model uses its original saved normalization.
support_definition: Marginal strain and within-history strain-rate invariant ranges, with conjunction recorded as an observable invariant box; this is not sufficient internal-state coverage.
statistical_units: 20 independent held-out loading histories; 25 initializations per condition/cohort. Predictions and time increments are not independent physical histories.

numerics.integration: implicit Euler, Newton-Raphson with residual-merit backtracking; no time subdivision or alternate solver
numerics.shear_convention: tensor components; tensor gradients divide shear derivatives by 2

scope: Fixed-budget material evidence only; no robot-control benefit claim. Known hard history is a previously inspected diagnostic, not a new blind test.

protocol.purpose: Bounded material transfer after R2 original-method results; not a completed experiment or robot-control claim
protocol.reference_protocol: Same 3D nonlinear reference material and interpretation as r2-rnn.json
protocol.initial_state: independently initialized virgin equilibrium for each complete history

boundary.free_recovery: zero external stress with strain and internal state solved; never clamp strain to zero

protocol.interpolation: piecewise_linear stress commands; times below are local to each phase
protocol.candidate_comparison: same 1 s window, peak stress and absolute stress-time integral (2.4 MPa*s); only timing differs
protocol.recovery_delay_note: Fixed project delays after the common candidate window; not a constant material tau. Assess reference recovery from the actual response without selecting favorable learned-model results.
state_rules: run the full observable prefix separately in each model
branch from each model's own physically reached state

metrics.rank_score: peak max(0,-epsilon_11) during common reload probe; smaller means less future compression, not full robot utility

protocol.protocol_provenance: Project transfer experiment, not an original TM02 figure or SuperMimic reproduction. Freeze before evaluation; no evaluation-based path or parameter selection.
